The Finite Element Method (FEM) and the Mixed Finite Element Method exhibit key differences, particularly when dealing with incompressible materials. Unlike the primal finite element method, which focuses on directly approximating primary variables like displacement, mixed methods introduce additional fields to the formulation of partial differential equations, allowing for independent approximation of variables like stress and strain.
